explication: NeMo Gym is a platform for evaluating and improving models and agents through stateful, verifiable task environments. The main workflow is to launch an evaluation, pair an agent harness and model with task data and an environment, execute rollouts (optionally in sandboxes and at scale), then score and inspect results. Separate capabilities include environment discovery and authoring, training integrations, rollout verification and comparison, observability, and export. The README establishes these product areas; sampled source excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal call wiring is not shown.
